title: Automa Browser Profile Configuration
description: JSON Schema specification for Automa browser profile files (*.browser.json)

id.description: Unique identifier for this browser profile

name.description: Display name of the browser profile

executable_path.description: Custom absolute path to the browser executable (optional)

user_data_dir.description: Directory where user profile data and cookies are persisted

headless.description: Launch browser without graphical user interface

proxy.description: Network proxy configuration for this profile

bypass.description: List of domains to bypass proxy

sideloaded_extensions.description: Array of folder paths containing unpacked extensions to load on launch

is_default.description: Whether this profile is the default target for single workflow runs
